responsibility: Implements INTEGER and CARDINAL text I/O over IOChan channels. It skips leading spaces, drives the WholeConv signed and unsigned scanners character by character through TextIO.ReadChar to accumulate decimal values and set channel ReadResults for terminator, format, or range cases, and formats output by converting numbers to DynamicStrings with StringConvert and emitting them through StringChan with field-width padding.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements whole-number I/O over IOChan: unlike the same-stem .def interface, it reads characters from channels using TextIO and WholeConv scanner states, applies SkipSpaces, and writes formatted numbers through StringConvert and StringChan.
